baselines.calendar_climatology: median training target of the target-week month, crop level, refitted with each refit
baselines.persistence: y_origin (origin-week median) for every horizon (primary baseline)
baselines.seasonal_naive: series weekly median 52 weeks before the TARGET week (weekly table at W + h - 52), scored where it exists, coverage reported (Phase 8 definition; not lag52, which is relative to the origin)

comparison_with_phase8: skill vs persistence only, side by side with Phase 8 validation (2019, 2020) and test (2021-2022) skills as context; absolute MAE/MAPE never compared across datasets
leakage_controls: no input before 2024-02-03; 2023 holdout never read (D-50)
test used once after a freeze manifest + run-once guard

learned_model.model: hgb_conservative (exploratory, at most one; never replaces the baselines as the primary result)
never: reuse or modify the frozen D-42/D-45 artefacts
tune anything after seeing test results

requires_approval.feature_set: Phase 8 features are daily-level (prev obs, 7/30/90-day rolling stats) and do not exist in the weekly candidate table. Proposed price-only set: lag1/lag2/lag4/lag52 ratios to y_origin, weeks_since_prev_obs, n_weeks_history, month sin/cos of the target week. This is a new feature set, not D-42 settings
requires_approval.selection_rule: Phase 8 required beating persistence on MAE in both validation years (+ bootstrap); proposed analogue: both validation quarters (2026 Q1 and Q2)

reusable_unchanged.refits: quarterly, first Sunday of the quarter, preprocessing fitted per refit
reusable_unchanged.scaling: price features divided by y_origin; y_origin itself as log (Phase 8 design_matrix)
reusable_unchanged.target: log(y_target / y_origin) (Phase 8 log_ratio), prediction = y_origin * exp(pred)
reusable_unchanged.training population: D-41 at the refit date (clarification 2); targets ending <= refit date

also: skill = 1 - MAE_model / MAE_persistence on identical rows
metrics.reporting: crop x horizon x period; each validation quarter separately and combined

population: eligible_d41 at the origin for evaluation; at the refit date for training
status: specified; frozen for approval; NOT executed
